statements.t: Our focus is on novel small molecule drugs developed both as monotherapy and in combination, which inhibit critical signaling pathways in cancer that promote cancer cell survival and tumor growth, including targeting RAS directly with KRAS G12D inhibition, targeting the pathway downstream with RAF/MEK inhibition, and targeting the parallel pathway that drives resistance with FAK inhibition.
In April 2026, we branded the trials as the VS-7375 TARGET-D Clinical Trial Program.
In the TARGET-D 101 Phase 1/2 study, we cleared multiple monotherapy dose levels, including the 1200 mg QD dose with no dose-limiting toxicities (“DLTs”) and no major toxicities.
We completed targeted enrollment in patients with pancreatic and lung cancer monotherapy cohorts and the colorectal cancer combination cohort with cetuximab in the Phase 1/2 study.

In the first half of 2026, we initiated three Phase 2 registration-directed trials of VS-7375, our oral KRAS G12D (ON/OFF) inhibitor, dosing the first patients in TARGET-D 201 (PDAC) in June 2026, and both TARGET-D 202 (NSCLC) and TARGET-D 203 (CRC) in July 2026.

We use our employee and infrastructure resources in a cross-functional manner across multiple research and development projects.

Under his leadership, the Company achieved accelerated FDA approval and commercial launch of AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA CO-PACK, while advancing VS-7375 into the clinic and rapidly towards a Phase 3 trial in metastatic pancreatic cancer in the first-line setting, which is expected to begin later this year.
He has positioned Verastem to enter a new chapter that we believe will deliver a potential best-in-class treatment for patients with KRAS G12D-driven tumors.
We are fortunate that Dan will continue to serve on our Board and as an advisor, providing valuable insight as we move forward.”
Importantly, he shares the Company’s values and commitment to patients, and I look forward to working with him to support a seamless transition.”
